errors.text_span: utilizes a linear scale ranging from 64 to 256, with tick labels at every 64 increments
errors.evidence: The x-axis does not use a linear scale; it displays discrete values (1632, 64, 128, 256) which are not spaced linearly. The range also incorrectly omits the value 1632, and the increments are not a constant 64.
The y-axis label in the figure is "Eval PPL.", including the period at the end.
The markers for the blue line (MoHD) are squares, not circles.
The blue line (MoHD) does not start at x=64; it starts at x=1632. Furthermore, the value at x=64 is approximately 10.5, not 10.0.
The value of the blue line (MoHD) at x=256 is approximately 10.6, not 10.9.
The red dashed line (Transformer) has a constant value of approximately 11.6, not 11.9. It also does not 'start' at x=64 but spans the entire x-axis range shown.
The value of the red dashed line (Transformer) is approximately 11.6, not 11.9.
The description omits any mention of the legend, which is necessary to identify which line corresponds to "Transformer" and which to "MoHD".
